text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... The Kikuka Sho... However I
look at it, it
feels a little out of my
reach... But I guess we did
get through
the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh. Hello, Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Suzuka?! What are you doing at the
Tokyo
Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you know... Anyway, what about
you? I don't
mean to pry, but you seem
a bit down.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well, I was just thinking about the
Kikuka
Sho. I'm worried about whether
I'll be able to run
such a long distance.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I guess we're both here to try
and
shake off our anxiety...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's so quiet... It's hard to believe all of
the
passion we experienced at the Derby
happened
here...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But I came here for the quiet. It lets me
see things
I couldn't see before. My
honest feelings, for
example.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Honest feelings?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A thought came to me when we were
running the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I considered not running in the Kikuka
Sho,
because I'd found something more
important to
me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What could be more important
than the
Classics?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I want to see how far I can go with

medium-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I saw it during the third corner of the
Derby—the
other side of speed. And I
want to see if I can get
there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The other side... of speed?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Is that a strange thing to say?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No way! If anything, it's really
impressive! The
other side of
speed—that sounds amazing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't really get it. But I'd
love to
be able to say something cool
like that someday!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I'll ever get to where you
are,
though... I mean, I get scared just
thinking about
how long the Kikuka Sho
is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has given me so much, but I
still can't
figure out what to do on my
own...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh? But I think you're pretty amazing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
For all the support you receive, you
always
manage to respond in kind. Isn't
that right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? I guess I did manage to
make it
all the way to the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I could never do something like that...
I'm not sure
how to accept other
people's emotions.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're much more amazing than you
think. You
should have some more
confidence in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll see you later. Good luck in the
Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I'm still not feeling confident. But
I'll do my
best.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh! One last thing!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um, I don't know how to put this, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm really, really, really happy that I got to run in the Derby with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka leaves with a smile on her
face.
